summary: Full backend + frontend test of the paper-trading crypto bot (Bitget mirror data, Claude Sonnet AI confirmation). Backend: 19/19 pytest pass (dashboard, meta, klines + 400s, bot start/stop/scan with SCAN log, settings persist + 6 validation 422 cases, position lifecycle via inject script incl. ~1% risk sizing, fees 0.055%/side, balance math, MANUAL close, 404/400, max_positions + duplicate-symbol RISK blocks, AI signal returns RECHAZADA/APROBADA with Spanish reasoning and correct executed flag, backtest + invalid 400, account reset, clear logs). Frontend: all requested testids exist; header badges, KPIs, watchlist->chart switch, 5 timeframe buttons (klines 200), canvas chart, plan panel, tabs, backtest (Turtle/SOL) results, settings save (button enables only after a change, toast 'Configuración guardada', plan/watchlist update), close position -> toast + history row, bot toggle, scan now, clear logs, reset dialog cancel/confirm all work. No JS errors. Two minor UI issues found.

minor.issue: 422 validation messages come from raw Pydantic and are in English ('Input should be less than or equal to 20'), and the Spanish UI shows them as-is in the toast.

ui_bugs.issue: Header action row overflows horizontally (scrollWidth 417 > 390); the 'Iniciar bot' button is cut off on the right.

issues: There are 7 KPIs in a 2-column grid, so the last row has an empty filled cell
The AI signals panel stretches to the height of the backtest tab and leaves a large empty area
Settings numeric inputs have no client-side min/max, so a user can type leverage 50 and only gets the server error

action_items: Fix mobile header overflow: wrap the buttons or let them shrink so bot-toggle-button is visible at 390px
Translate or map the Pydantic 422 errors into Spanish messages, or add min/max on the settings inputs
Optional: fill the empty KPI grid cell on mobile
critical_code_review_comments: engine._handle_signal checks the risk limits (max_positions, duplicate symbol) outside self.lock while open_position takes the lock. If several signals are handled at once, max_positions could be exceeded. Re-check the limits inside the lock in open_position.
Signals blocked by RISK are never stored in the signals collection; they only appear in the logs, so they are not visible in the AI panel or history.
_monitor_once closes a TP/SL hit at the 5s ticker price rather than the SL/TP level. This is acceptable for paper trading, but large gaps can make the SL fill worse than the planned 1% risk.
reset_account does not clear engine.signal_keys. This is harmless, but a signal with the same candle key will not re-trigger after a reset.
pytest.ini enables xdist (-n auto). The tests share global state (account and settings), so run them with '-p no:xdist -o addopts=""'.
seed_data_creation: Test signals injected via the inject script (XRP, ETH, AVAX, LINK, SOL). Everything was cleaned up with POST /api/account/reset at the end.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run the backend tests sequentially: cd /app/backend && REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=... pytest tests/test_trading_bot.py -p no:xdist -o addopts=''. The session fixture restores the default settings, stops the bot and resets the account. Provider is bitget (Bybit is geo-blocked, which is expected). The AI test takes about 15s. Final state: default settings, bot STOPPED, account reset to 10000.
